official_config_differences: Official CIFAR config uses 5 initial classes and 5-class increments; matched implementation check uses the agreed 10-class split.
Official class shuffle is disabled for the matched implementation check.
Pretrained checkpoint is pinned to the selected AugReg IN21K->IN1K family rather than inferred from an alias.
validation.repeat_policy: Start with matched seed 1993; expand to 3 seeds when differences or uncertainty justify it.
validation.margin_policy: Review the matched official reference before fixing a margin. A single reference seed does not measure seed variability; additional seeds are a separate decision. Fix the margin before native acceptance evaluation. Below-threshold accuracy blocks merging.

efficiency.flops: paired diagnostic pass kept separate from measurement

before_port_acceptance: Decide and freeze the accuracy margin; decide whether additional reference seeds are needed.
Authorize the native first-two-task acceptance run as a separate stage.
Use the pinned Base checkpoint and the matched class/sample/transform/loader protocol.
remaining_steps: One-task/one-epoch efficiency pilot with separate FLOPs pass
